thread:
Jamie: Quick sync — infra flagged SSO v2 as high-risk for this launch. We need to re-stitch the release plan: keep full SSO and slip launch, or remove/flag it for v1. 1pm triage?
Kevin: On it. Can we get customer impact data before we decide? @Sara can you pull pilot list?
Sara: Two pilots depend on it: AcmeCorp and NimbusHealth. Both are ok deferring if we provide an interim auth path.
Ali: From eng: full SSO v2 is ~3w dev + 1w infra + extra test cycles. If we drop it, we save ~4w.
Monica: Design note: deferring will need a temporary banner and support doc. Banner ~2 days, admin UX changes longer.
Jamie: Options: A) delay launch ~3-4w to keep SSO v2, B) remove from MVP and add to v1, C) ship behind feature-flag + canary for pilots. Thoughts?
Kevin: My vote is C if infra can support a strict canary. Keeps launch date and covers pilots.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag service capacity OK. Canary routing templates available: https://internal/ff-templates (ops doc).
Ali: We can build a controlled FF path. Rough scope: 5 dev days (flag + gated routing + tests) + 1 infra ticket. Much less than full SSO.
Sara: AcmeCorp/Nimbus prefer option C — want to be able to opt-in rather than wait for v1.
Monica: I can ship the banner and a quick admin toggle mock in 2 days. Will need to sync API with Ali for the toggle surface.
Jamie: Decision: go with C (flagged canary). Action items:
- Ali: scope infra + tests and open infra ticket (est 5 dev days).
- Monica: banner + admin-toggle mock (2d).
- Sara: confirm pilots and draft opt-in comms.
- Kevin: schedule canary cadence and rollback plan with SRE.
I'll update roadmap and milestone tracker after action items land.
Ali: Quick question — do we want FF gating by org-id or by auth-email domain? org-id is safer for pilots.
Sara: org-id gating works for both pilots.
Kevin: SRE prefers org-id. Also note we should add a telemetry flag for auth errors.
Monica: noted — I'll add banner copy for the opt-in flow and a fallback notice.
Jamie: Final note: treat SSO v2 as "v1-scope" after this. If anything blocks the FF path, we will reassess at weekly triage. :thumbsup:
Sara: I'll message the CS reps now and loop in the pilots.
Ali: Starting scoping now, will drop a PR with checklist by EOD.
Kevin: I scheduled a 30m follow-up 2pm to confirm infra tickets.
Jamie: Thanks team — good move.
